news.paragraph: The United States Oil Fund (USO) has seen significant price appreciation in 2026, with recent reports highlighting a crude inventory decline impacting its stock. While one article suggests USO and BNO have both soared over 100%, another points to falling WTI crude oil prices below $87. The UAE's exit from OPEC+ has also been cited as a factor in oil holding around $100.
